title: ग्रामर: विशेषण से क्रिया-विशेषण (-ly)
Grammar: visheshan se kriya-visheshan (-ly)
Grammar in Use: adjectives to adverbs (-ly)

card: विशेषण (adjective) बताता है कोई कैसा है: a happy boy। क्रिया-विशेषण (adverb) बताता है काम कैसे हुआ: he smiled happily। ज़्यादातर में -ly लगता है। happy में y → i: happily।
Visheshan (adjective) bataata hai koi kaisa hai: a happy boy. Kriya-visheshan (adverb) bataata hai kaam kaise hua: he smiled happily. Zyaadatar mein -ly lagta hai. happy mein y → i: happily.
An adjective tells what someone is like: a happy boy. An adverb tells how something is done: he smiled happily. Most add -ly; happy changes y to i: happily.
